# Text Highlighter (`fancy/text-highlighter`)

Marker-style highlight that sweeps across a phrase when it scrolls into view.

- **Weight**: 0.9 KiB JS + 0.1 KiB CSS (own, gzip); 50 KiB with vendor deps. **Lite**: true. **Touch**: true. **Reduced motion**: static.
- **License**: MIT, tier A, from `danielpetho/fancy@f9f62c61207b` by daniel petho.
- **Deps**: `motion`.

## Usage

```tsx
import { TextHighlighter } from "./kit/fancy/text-highlighter";

<TextHighlighter as={…} triggerType={…} transition={…} />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `as` | `ElementType?` |
| `triggerType` | `"hover" \| "ref" \| "inView" \| "auto"?` |
| `transition` | `Transition?` |
| `useInViewOptions` | `UseInViewOptions?` |
| `highlightColor` | `string?` |
| `direction` | `HighlightDirection?` |

## Compose

1. Inside a shell `.panel` as the screen's one hero element, with the headline in `--font-body` and labels in `.kicker`.
2. As a row in a list/card (`.item`, `.card`) where it is decoration for the text next to it — then it must be `aria-hidden`.

## Failure modes

- Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the final frame renders immediately; make sure that frame is complete.
- Pulls `motion` (shared with other motion components; counted once per app).

## Air tokens

Colours, radii and fonts come from `kit/air/theme.css` custom properties (`--ink`, `--accent`, `--panel-bg`, `--ring`, `--radius-*`, `--font-*`); pass them through `className`/`style`, never literals.
